title: Native ContractGraph-QA to canonical ProofPath SCIG segment

ideaContract.purpose: Replace the synthetic ContractGraph-QA to ProofPath heartbeat edge with a native producer and native canonical consumer while preserving one logical operation, exact evidence identity, and zero authority transfer.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: A real ContractGraph-QA provider-decision evidence pack is replay-verified, projected into canonical ProofPath SCIG v0.1, accepted by the native Rust proofpath-scig verifier at the manifest-declared capability commit, and bound into a deterministic non-authorizing bridge receipt.
invariants: the source ContractGraph-QA evidence pack passes exact deterministic replay before projection
the same logical_operation_id survives the CGQA to ProofPath boundary
the canonical CGQA evidence-pack digest is preserved in the ProofPath projection and receipt
ProofPath consumption uses only manifest-declared CANONICAL proofpath.scig.v0.1 bytes
the ContractGraph-QA to ProofPath edge transfers no execution or mutation authority
native ProofPath verification is evidence validation and never a capability grant
forbiddenOutcomes: consuming a PROPOSED or EXPERIMENTAL ProofPath capability as ambient system behavior
treating current ProofPath repository head as interchangeable with exact SCIG capability identity
projecting a tampered CGQA evidence pack
allowing claim-boundary metadata to invent production or financial authority
carrying an authorization_ref from ContractGraph-QA into ProofPath
describing the CGQA bridge receipt as a native ProofPath signed receipt
ideaContract.parentContract: NEO REZONANS System Contract v0.1 / ContractGraph-QA -> ProofPath authorityMode=NONE

evidence.claim: ContractGraph-QA builds and exact-replay verifies the provider decision evidence pack before any cross-repository projection.
The current ProofPath manifest identifies proofpath.scig.v0.1 as CANONICAL, default-consumable, with canonical capability commit 685d50e256a5125a21f4c4584b326411caaa64ad.
The bridge binds logical operation identity, CGQA pack digest, canonical ProofPath capability identity, and an explicit NONE authority transfer into SCIG v0.1 extensions.
The native Rust proofpath-scig verifier validates the generated SCIG document at the exact manifest-declared canonical capability commit.
Negative controls reject pack tamper, authority-claim mutation, wrong ProofPath capability identity, invalid native verifier output, and reintroduced authority.

past.summary: FCRP-SYSTEM-002 proved the complete system heartbeat using synthetic stage producers, including a synthetic ContractGraph-QA to ProofPath stage.

present.summary: The first native segment replaces that synthetic boundary with actual ContractGraph-QA evidence replay plus the canonical native ProofPath SCIG verifier while keeping the system authority boundary unchanged.

future.summary: Additional synthetic stages may be replaced one by one only when native capability identity and non-transfer semantics are machine-verifiable without depending on branch-only architecture.

causalPath.statement: SYSTEM-002 proves continuity at the CGQA to ProofPath edge synthetically but does not execute either repository's native evidence/verifier contract for that transfer.
ContractGraph-QA produces a provider decision evidence pack and exact-replays the embedded adapter, observations, authority evidence, and derived payment decision.
A narrow adapter projects only verified CGQA evidence and explicit non-authority metadata into the additive extension surface of SCIG v0.1.

The current ProofPath manifest is consulted for lifecycle state, then the exact canonical proofpath.scig.v0.1 capability commit is checked out and its native Rust verifier consumes the projected SCIG.
A deterministic bridge receipt binds CGQA pack digest, logical operation identity, exact ProofPath capability commit and native VALID result while authorityTransfer remains NONE.

navigation.reason: The missing proof is a sibling repository transfer boundary: the whole-system topology is already canonical, but this exact CGQA-to-ProofPath edge still uses synthetic producers in SYSTEM-002.

refactor.change: Introduce a minimal native bridge from replay-verified ContractGraph-QA provider evidence to canonical ProofPath SCIG v0.1, bind exact capability identity, and retain authorityMode=NONE.
refactor.expectedEffect: The first heartbeat segment becomes native on both sides without importing branch-only ProofPath capabilities or widening authority semantics.

authorization.authorityBoundary: SYSTEM-003 proves evidence portability and native SCIG validation only. The ContractGraph-QA to ProofPath system edge remains authorityMode=NONE, and PASS grants no repository, runtime, payment, deployment, or external-effect authority.
